data.investment_objective: To generate stable returns by investing predominantly in debt & money market instruments issued by Banks, Public Sector Units (PSUs) & Public Financial Institutions (PFIs). The scheme shall endeavor to generate optimum returns with low credit risk.
data.asset_allocation: Debt & Money Market Instruments issued by Banks, Public Financial Institutions (PFIs) and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) - (80%-100%), Debt (including government securities) and Money Market Instruments issued by entities other than Banks, PFIs and PSUs - (0%-20%)
data.benchmark: Nifty Banking & PSU Debt Index A-II
data.fund_managers: Mr. Aditya Pagaria, Mr. Hardik Shah
